topic: How to Get Rid of Garbage Disposal Odor
notes: Treat odor as likely food buildup and keep hands out of the disposal. Power must be off/disconnected before cleaning accessible baffle areas. Use the manufacturer's cold-water operating guidance and only manufacturer-supported freshening methods. Do not recommend bleach, drain cleaner or unknown chemical mixtures in the disposal.
